title: Scientific PDF Parsing and Case Result Schemas

source_entry_schema.claim_or_field: string - output field name or claim summary
source_entry_schema.printed_page: string or null - printed page label if present
source_entry_schema.block_id: string or list[string] - block_id / table_id / eq_id from parsed_document.json
source_entry_schema.quote: string - exact short verbatim snippet from source

uncertainty_entry_schema.target: string - field, page, table, or equation affected
uncertainty_entry_schema.reason: string - scanned_no_text_layer | garbled_font | complex_layout | not_reported_in_source | conflict_in_source | missing_tool
uncertainty_entry_schema.human_handoff: string - exact page/bbox/file for human verification
